_comment:
GILFOYLE AUTONOMOUS CREW (5 stages) via the subagent (crew) tool: probe -> design -> plan -> build -> gate. Before submission the orchestrator adopts an existing adequate spec or recorded explicit requested outcomes in the current run directory. Interrogation and dated verbatim approval are required only for actual unresolved material spec decisions; applicable existing approvals remain valid. The engine substitutes only {task} (= the accepted behavior-source path) into prompt_template; forward depends_on edges order stages but do not pipe predecessor text. Stages read handoff files in RUN DIRECTORY = dirname({task}); preserve existing spec.md when applicable, related-issues.md, probe-notes.md, conditional probe.*, design.md, plan.md, and status.md there. No new route/stage/artifact is created by adoption. The sole loop edge gate -> build injects gate feedback into build.

EVIDENCE: select sufficient behavioral tests, real consumer/native/integration execution, captured reference facts, and compiler/dependency checks or ordinary independent review first. Probe scripts and cross-checks are conditional on unresolved design-relevant facts. Custom oracles/mutations/fuzz/stress machinery require a named uncovered mechanism or explicit repository requirement; do not build a second implementation solely to prove the first. Preserve required regression coverage, real-defect sensitivity, actual performance obligations, and repository gates. Failed, unavailable, stale, or deferred required proof remains blocking. Retain valid source/input/environment-linked evidence; reverify affected conclusions.

ROUTING: CLASS A is a repair whose correct outcome is determined by approved claims/reference facts/repository obligations, with unchanged behavior/coverage/architecture/risk and wholly inside one slice's exact planned file set. It may self-heal within build 3x/test 5x caps; gate emits summary(changes_needed) + NEEDS_WORK. No universal oracle-on-input discriminator applies, and a red regression alone does not falsify design. CLASS B is a genuine unresolved contradiction, changed/ambiguous behavior/scope/ownership/interfaces/architecture/comparison meaning/risk decision, missing necessary approval, or out-of-slice work. Write HALT_FALSIFIED with implicated leg, evidence, owner, and dependent work, then summary(terminal); never loop or retry across a halt. Each downstream stage reads status.md first and only re-echoes an existing HALT_FALSIFIED. Permitted proof owners may correct instruments/expectations against governing facts while preserving coverage; control-plane/read-only boundaries remain.

BUILD remains one stage because slices are planned at runtime. It walks atomic slices in order and records delivered behavior, performed checks/results, and unresolved failures once per slice/repair in status.md. GATE judges the assembled change with required caller/native/platform/repository proof and substantive ordinary independent review, revalidating repairs and affected interactions. Completion needs every applicable obligation satisfied with no blocking failure; intermediate green slices are not final integration. Supplied feature budgets distinguish production from tests/proof; soft overruns need a plan explanation, existing hard-cap changes need owner authorization. No universal numeric slice-size/time/file/per-loop threshold applies.

LOOP BOUNDS remain configured upfront: trigger >= 4 chars, max_iterations 1..=10, no self-loops. This crew keeps gate -> build, trigger NEEDS_WORK, max_iterations 5. Non-convergent or exhausted Class-A work becomes HALT_FALSIFIED, never silent success or an extra run. Stages remain leaves and use the project's own commands.
task: <<path to the accepted outcome source in the run directory, e.g. .inbox-unread-count/spec.md or an existing applicable outcome record; adopt explicit/approved outcomes and interrogate/record approval only for actual unresolved material decisions>>

stages.name: probe
stages.prompt_template:
Run prove-it-prototype for the feature specified at: {task}

RUN DIRECTORY = the directory that contains {task} (dirname of the accepted behavior-source path). All existing handoff paths remain there; '<rundir>/' refers to it.

FIRST read <rundir>/status.md; if it contains HALT_FALSIFIED, do nothing except summary(resultType='terminal') re-echoing the halt reason. Otherwise read the accepted behavior source and the workflow contract, adopting applicable existing spec approval or recorded explicit requested outcomes without fresh interrogation/sign-off. Name only specific factual premises whose answers could change design. Consult applicable documentation, source, tests, captured references, and valid observations first; reuse prior related-issue evidence or make a bounded tracker search into <rundir>/related-issues.md. Observe only remaining uncertainty through the smallest safe existing command/test or direct real system entry point. Write disposable probe.* only when necessary, with no universal line limit. Never mutate/delete existing code/environment state. Cross-check interpreted/transformed output only for a named relevant blind spot; custom oracle/fuzz/mutation machinery requires a named coverage gap or repository requirement, not a second implementation solely to prove the first.

Record premises, dependent decisions, source/revision, inputs/environment, commands/results, safety, and validated/learned conclusions in <rundir>/probe-notes.md; conditional Probe/Oracle sections state their need. Correct instruments against independently established facts, not merely to force agreement. Apply the contract's Verification complexity stop. If required premises are answered, summary(resultType='terminal') names evidence and learning; a false assumption now answered is learning, not automatic substrate failure. A genuine unresolved contradiction, necessary unapproved decision, or required failed/unavailable proof writes HALT_FALSIFIED to <rundir>/status.md with evidence, owner, and dependent work, then summary(resultType='terminal') echoes it. Link/file a verified issue for actual underlying defects without treating it as a waiver. Do NOT design, plan, or write feature code.

stages.name: design
stages.prompt_template:
Run falsifiable-design for the feature specified at: {task}

RUN DIRECTORY = the directory that contains {task} (dirname of the accepted behavior-source path); '<rundir>/' refers to it.

FIRST read <rundir>/status.md; if it contains HALT_FALSIFIED, do nothing except summary(resultType='terminal') re-echoing the halt reason. Otherwise read the accepted behavior source, <rundir>/probe-notes.md and applicable sources/probe, and the workflow contract. Reuse explicit/approved outcomes without manufacturing interrogation or fresh approval; necessary unresolved product/risk decisions remain owner gates. Group observable outcomes, compatibility/safety boundaries, important errors, and plausible introduced failures; inspect relevant callers and guarantees of removed guards/ordering/validation. Place responsibility in approved cohesive owners/interfaces. Write <rundir>/design.md with numbered claim IDs and a ## Falsification table covering Claim and covered cases, Falsifier / verification with expected results, Regression coverage, and Status. Choose sufficient behavioral tests, real caller/native/integration execution, captured references with provenance/approved fidelity, and compiler/dependency checks or ordinary review first. Custom oracles/fuzz/live comparisons/named mutations require a named uncovered mechanism or repository requirement; no second implementation solely to prove the first. Preserve required regression coverage and observed real-defect sensitivity; additional mutations need the declared gap and red/restored-green proof.

Planned implementation checks may be PENDING with owner/step; no universal cheapest-falsifier run before approval. Required failed/unavailable premise proof blocks dependent decisions/implementation. Record applicable placement, non-goals with reasons, future work with verified tracker IDs, supplied-budget/hard-limit decisions, and necessary dated requester/delegated approvals. Omit inapplicable instrument fields, never required obligations. Approved settled decisions and resolved required premises hand off via summary(resultType='terminal'), identifying remaining implementation-check owners. Genuine unresolved contradiction, missing necessary approval, changed/ambiguous product/architecture/risk decision, or failed/unavailable required premise evidence writes HALT_FALSIFIED to <rundir>/status.md naming evidence, owner, and dependent work, then summary(resultType='terminal') echoes it. A red implementation/regression check alone does not establish a changed design. Do NOT write a plan or feature code.

stages.name: plan
stages.prompt_template:
Run budgeted-plan for the feature specified at: {task}

RUN DIRECTORY = the directory that contains {task} (dirname of the accepted behavior-source path); '<rundir>/' refers to it.

FIRST read <rundir>/status.md; if it contains HALT_FALSIFIED, do nothing except summary(resultType='terminal') re-echoing the halt reason. Otherwise read the workflow contract and approved <rundir>/design.md. Group outcomes/claims into independently-green atomic changes with observable checks, using approved ownership seams. Signature/interface changes and every caller migration land together regardless of file count. Write compact slices in <rundir>/plan.md: Outcome; Changes including owners/interfaces and Files: exact planned paths; Verification with expected results or valid evidence references; Dependencies only when relevant. Preserve relevant behavioral/regression/boundary checks, real caller/native/integration proof, repository requirements, and justified design-required comparison/performance/oracle/mutation checks. Additional stress/per-loop/oracle fields need an actual obligation or named uncovered mechanism; no universal numeric size/time/file threshold or per-symbol receipt applies.

Pending premises block only dependent slices; implementation checks get owners. Record delivery increments only for requested delivery or genuinely independent seams. Record requester/repository-supplied feature budgets once, production versus tests/proof; explain soft overruns with unchanged scope/architecture, but require owner authorization for changing/exceeding explicit hard caps or enforced repository limits. Preserve readable cohesive ownership. Apply doc-comment-as-contract and output-stream rules, tracker taxonomy, and self-review of caller migration/coverage/ownership/dependencies without a mandatory self-review artifact. Hand off via summary(resultType='terminal') when approved work and applicable checks are covered; a genuine contradiction, necessary missing approval, or changed/ambiguous product/architecture/risk decision writes HALT_FALSIFIED with owner/evidence/dependent work. Do NOT write feature code.

stages.name: build
stages.prompt_template:
Run checkpointed-build with tdd-scoped inside each slice for the feature specified at: {task}

RUN DIRECTORY = the directory that contains {task} (dirname of the accepted behavior-source path); '<rundir>/' refers to it.

FIRST read <rundir>/status.md; if it contains HALT_FALSIFIED, do nothing except summary(resultType='terminal') re-echoing the halt reason. Read the workflow contract, <rundir>/plan.md, <rundir>/design.md, and applicable <rundir>/probe-notes.md evidence. Critique affected Outcome/Changes/Verification/Dependencies; required unresolved premises block dependent implementation. Implement atomic slices ONE AT A TIME in order. Use symbol-aware impact analysis plus dynamic/export/documentation search and source/dependency helper reuse; migrate all affected callers atomically. Use RED->GREEN->REFACTOR where behavior needs focused coverage, reusing sufficient existing tests and preserving real regression reproducers/observed bug sensitivity. Run applicable behavioral/boundary/regression/repository checks and real caller/native/integration proof; captured comparisons use provenance/approved fidelity. Custom oracle/mutation/stress/performance protocols require a declared gap or repository obligation. Inspect relevant parallel-path symmetry and preserve required enforcement; no per-symbol receipts or universal per-loop budgets.

CLASS A repairs are determined by approved outcomes/reference facts/repository obligations with unchanged behavior/coverage/architecture/risk, wholly inside THIS slice's exact planned Files set. Diagnose/repair within unchanged build 3x/test 5x caps; never blindly rerun, skip required checks, or manufacture expected values from current output. An independent oracle is not a universal prerequisite, and a red regression does not itself falsify design. Permitted proof owners may correct demonstrated instrument/expectation defects against governing facts. CLASS B is a genuine unresolved contradiction, necessary unapproved/ambiguous or changed behavior/scope/ownership/interfaces/architecture/comparison meaning/risk decision, or work outside planned files. Write HALT_FALSIFIED to <rundir>/status.md with implicated leg/evidence/owner/dependent work and summary(resultType='terminal'); never retry across it. Do not edit upstream oracle/spec/design/plan artifacts from build. Apply the contract's separate checker/product-repair stops.

Sweep stale references/dead cutover paths and reverify invalidated evidence. Stage exact planned paths only, never git add -A or git add .; commit one independently-green slice/atomic repair only when applicable checks have valid proof and no blocking failure remains. Record delivered behavior, performed checks/results, and unresolved failures in <rundir>/status.md; amend affected records on repair and identify pending final integration. Discover/fetch actual upstream and check material drift. Apply supplied budgets and existing hard limits under the contract. LOOP RE-ENTRY from NEEDS_WORK addresses ONLY named eligible Class-A gaps, preserving unrelated valid evidence; out-of-slice or genuine changed/ambiguous decisions halt, not further loops.

stages.name: gate
stages.prompt_template:
Run checkpointed-build's FINAL integration check for the feature specified at: {task}

RUN DIRECTORY = the directory that contains {task} (dirname of the accepted behavior-source path); '<rundir>/' refers to it.

FIRST read <rundir>/status.md; if it contains HALT_FALSIFIED, do nothing except summary(resultType='terminal') re-echoing it. Otherwise read the workflow contract and approved obligations. Independently establish assembled behavior, all caller migrations, relevant cross-slice interactions, required real consumer/native/platform execution, behavioral/boundary/regression coverage, and repository build/test/lint/CI checks. Run missing/invalidated checks, retaining valid source/input/environment-linked evidence with applicability reasons. Additional oracle/mutation/stress/performance proof applies only to a declared gap/requirement. Preserve required bug sensitivity. Perform substantive ordinary independent review covering behavior/ownership/interfaces/dependencies/risks against approved decisions; independently review repair diffs/affected interactions, broadening if assumptions changed. Isolated reconstruction is conditional on an explicit requester requirement or named unresolved architectural risk ordinary review cannot answer. Confirm atomic green slice/repair commits and reconcile evidence in <rundir>/status.md.

ROUTE using approved claims, test expectations, captured references, and independent facts, not a universal oracle-on-input test. CLASS A only: the contract determines the correction with unchanged behavior/coverage/architecture/risk, and one slice's exact planned files contain it; summary(resultType='changes_needed') with NEEDS_WORK, governing claim/evidence and categorized FAILING implementation/build/test/fence defects, MISSING required coverage/proof/outcomes, and BUDGET only for actual obligations/supplied limits. A red regression can be an implementation defect, not design falsification. CLASS B / necessary decision: genuine unresolved contradiction, changed/ambiguous behavior/scope/ownership/interfaces/architecture/comparison meaning/risk, missing necessary approval, out-of-slice work, or proof unavailable to eligible repair; write HALT_FALSIFIED with implicated leg/evidence/owner/dependent work to <rundir>/status.md and summary(resultType='terminal'), never loop. NON-CONVERGENCE: unresolved repeated Class-A repairs or exhaustion of the 5-iteration gate cap become HALT_FALSIFIED with remaining failures/owners, never another run. ALL GREEN: every applicable assembled consumer/native/repository/review obligation has valid proof and no blocking failure; summary(resultType='terminal') reports delivered behavior, performed checks/results, unresolved failures (none), and applicable non-goal/tracker references. Do NOT write feature code or edit oracles.
